author: Fextralife
description:
The Duskbloods Reaction - Network Test ANNOUNCED, And Everything We Know So Far
In this video, we're going to be talking a little bit about The Duskbloods. If you have not heard at Nintendo Direct yesterday. The Duskbloods had a new trailer shown, which was very short but they have also announced that there is going to be a closed network test for the game this summer. They did not specify exactly when that will be, but we're going to talk a little bit about what we saw in the trailer.
